scenario: Submit a complete owner-occupied application with year built 2005 and roof year 2020.
expected: Application advances to eligibility and all entered values are retained.

scenario: Omit property address and submit.
expected: Submission is blocked and property address is flagged as required.

scenario: Enter year built as 1849 when configured minimum is 1850.
expected: Validation fails and no quote is created.

scenario: Submit an eligible owner-occupied home in a supported state and eligible protection class.
expected: Eligibility passes to rating.

scenario: Submit a property in a state absent from the configured supported-state list.
expected: Quote is blocked with the configured unsupported-state reason code.

scenario: Submit a property exactly at the configured maximum eligible age.
expected: Configured inclusive/exclusive boundary rule is applied and recorded.

scenario: Select dwelling limit $300,000 and $1,000 deductible from configured options.
expected: Selections are saved and shown on the quote.

scenario: Enter dwelling limit $275,000 when only $250,000 and $300,000 are configured.
expected: Invalid limit is rejected with a field-level message.

scenario: Submit a deductible of $2,500 when the configured maximum is $2,000.
expected: Submission is blocked and no quote is saved.

scenario: Use controlled factors whose expected term premium is $1,250.00 before tax/fees.
expected: Term premium displays as $1,250.00; configured taxes and fees are separate line items.

scenario: Set quote start date to the effective date of rating version V2.
expected: V2 is used for the quote.

scenario: Rate identical inputs twice with the same rating version.
expected: Both calculations return identical premium and line items.

scenario: Bind a valid quote with terms accepted and payment method confirmed.
expected: Unique policy number is created and issued coverages match the quote.

scenario: Attempt to bind an expired quote.
expected: Binding is blocked and recalculation is required.

scenario: Register a loss dated one day before policy effective date.
expected: FNOL registration is blocked with policy-not-in-force reason code.

scenario: Submit a commercial vehicle with all required business and vehicle details.
expected: Application advances and vehicle is linked to the business.

scenario: Omit legal business name.
expected: Submission is blocked and the missing field is identified.

scenario: Enter a 16-character VIN.
expected: VIN validation fails and no quote is created.

scenario: Submit an eligible business with two eligible vehicles.
expected: Risk proceeds to rating.

scenario: Submit a business class on the configured prohibited list.
expected: Quote is blocked with the configured reason code.

scenario: Submit a fleet one vehicle above the auto-quote threshold.
expected: Application is routed to configured fleet underwriting/referral rather than rated as standard risk.

scenario: Select $1,000,000 combined single limit and collision with $1,000 deductible.
expected: Selections are saved exactly.

scenario: Enter a liability limit absent from configured options.
expected: Invalid limit is rejected.

scenario: Submit comprehensive deductible while comprehensive is not selected.
expected: Request is rejected and no deductible is stored for that coverage.

scenario: Use controlled rating data with expected term premium $4,800.00 before taxes/fees.
expected: Premium is $4,800.00 and taxes/fees are separate.

scenario: Apply 7% fleet credit to eligible premium of $5,000.00.
expected: Credit equals $350.00 and appears once.

scenario: Submit duplicate fleet-credit indicators.
expected: Credit is applied no more than once.

scenario: Bind a valid fleet quote and compare vehicles on issued policy with quote.
expected: Policy and insured vehicles match quote.

scenario: Add a vehicle effective halfway through the policy term.
expected: A separate endorsement reference and prorated additional premium are recorded.

scenario: Repeat bind request with the same idempotency key.
expected: No duplicate policy is created.

scenario: Submit complete application for $500,000 face amount and 20-year term.
expected: Application is saved and advances to underwriting.

scenario: Omit a required beneficiary allocation.
expected: Submission is blocked and beneficiary details are flagged.

scenario: Select a term length not present in configured product options.
expected: Invalid term is rejected.

scenario: Submit applicant within configured age and face-amount limits with acceptable answers.
expected: Application receives configured eligible/next-step status.

scenario: Submit residence state not supported for this product.
expected: Application is blocked with unsupported-residency reason.

scenario: Answer Yes to a configured mandatory medical referral question.
expected: Application is referred to manual underwriting and not auto-approved.

scenario: Use controlled rate data specifying monthly premium $42.50 for the test profile.
expected: Monthly premium displays as $42.50 and payment mode is clear.

scenario: Start policy on the effective date of a new rating version.
expected: The newly effective version is used.

scenario: Recalculate unchanged inputs using the same version.
expected: Premium and fees are identical.

scenario: Enter two primary beneficiaries with allocations of 60% and 40%.
expected: Application accepts allocations totalling 100%.

scenario: Enter allocations totalling 90%.
expected: Submission is blocked with allocation-total error.

scenario: Enter allocations totalling 100.01%.
expected: Submission is blocked; total must equal 100%.

scenario: Issue approved application after acceptance and payment confirmation.
expected: Unique policy number is created and policy details match accepted terms.

scenario: Attempt issue while underwriting status is Pending.
expected: Issue is blocked.

scenario: Request cancellation on the last day of the configured 30-day free-look period.
expected: Free-look cancellation is accepted and configured refund/status is recorded.

scenario: Submit valid whole-life application with monthly mode and configured payment duration.
expected: Application advances with funding choices retained.

scenario: Omit required payment duration.
expected: Submission is blocked and missing duration is identified.

scenario: Select a paid-up option unavailable for the chosen product variant.
expected: Option is rejected and not persisted.

scenario: Submit at the configured minimum issue age.
expected: Minimum-age boundary follows the configured inclusive rule.

scenario: Submit one day below the minimum issue age.
expected: Application is blocked or referred per configured lower-bound rule.

scenario: Submit a prohibited residence state.
expected: Application is blocked with configured reason code.

scenario: Use controlled table specifying monthly premium $125.00 for test profile.
expected: Monthly premium equals $125.00; guaranteed values are labelled.

scenario: Switch monthly to annual premium mode.
expected: Annual premium uses the configured modal factor.

scenario: Recalculate identical inputs with same product version.
expected: Premium and guaranteed values are identical.

scenario: Retrieve configured guaranteed cash value for policy year 5.
expected: Displayed value matches the configured schedule.

scenario: Request loan equal to available loan amount.
expected: Request passes limit validation and transaction is recorded.

scenario: Request loan one cent above available amount.
expected: Request is blocked and no loan transaction is created.

scenario: Issue approved application with terms accepted and payment confirmed.
expected: Policy number is created and details match accepted application.

scenario: Attempt issue with outstanding underwriting requirements.
expected: Issue is blocked.

scenario: Simulate declined initial premium payment.
expected: Policy is not marked paid; payment failure and configured collection status are recorded.

scenario: Create and save a complete application.
expected: Unique application reference and configured initial status are created.

scenario: Retrieve application by its reference.
expected: Correct application and audit history are returned.

scenario: Search using an unknown application reference.
expected: Not-found response is returned without exposing another applicant's data.

scenario: Complete all required disclosures and record required evidence.
expected: Application proceeds to underwriting decision.

scenario: Leave one mandatory disclosure unanswered.
expected: Submission is blocked or status remains Incomplete.

scenario: Mark required medical report outstanding and attempt approval.
expected: Approval is blocked and status remains Pending Evidence.

scenario: Record Approve decision for a complete eligible application.
expected: Status becomes Approved and issue eligibility is enabled.

scenario: Record Decline with configured reason code.
expected: Status becomes Declined and reason is retained.

scenario: Trigger referral rule and attempt policy issue before review completion.
expected: Issue is blocked while status remains Referred/Pending Review.

scenario: Generate issued policy documents and compare face amount, premium, term and beneficiaries.
expected: Documents match issued policy data.

scenario: Attempt protected policy-field update as unauthorised user.
expected: Update is rejected and data remains unchanged.

scenario: Review audit history after a valid policy change.
expected: Audit shows actor, timestamp and changed fields as configured.

scenario: Change beneficiaries to allocations totalling 100%.
expected: Change is saved with effective date and audit trail.

scenario: Submit beneficiary changes totalling 95%.
expected: Change is blocked until allocation totals 100%.

scenario: Register death notice dated before policy effective date.
expected: Notice is blocked or referred according to configured in-force rule with reason recorded.
